description: issue #690: `note`'s duration MUST be positive; a non-positive value (here 0) raises `ol-range` at runtime (spec/error-model.md) and emits no `sound` event. A negative or non-finite value is folded into the same guard. The pitch is validated before the duration, so a valid pitch with a bad duration still reaches this range check. The instruction event is still emitted for the statement before the diagnostic halts it.
